arxiv-1912-02118.title: Thermodynamic Evidence of Proximity to a Kitaev Spin-Liquid in Ag 3 LiIr 2 O 6
arxiv-1912-02118.creator: Faranak Bahrami, William Lafargue-Dit-Hauret, Oleg I. Lebedev, Roman Movshovich, Hung-Yu Yang, David Broido, Xavier Rocquefelte, Fazel Tafti
arxiv-1912-02118.description: A 2019 arXiv research paper by Faranak Bahrami, William Lafargue-Dit-Hauret, Oleg I. Lebedev, Roman Movshovich, Hung-Yu Yang, David Broido, Xavier Rocquefelte, Fazel Tafti. Kitaev magnets are materials with bond-dependent Ising interactions between localized spins on a honeycomb lattice. Such interactions could lead to a quantum spin-liquid (QSL) ground state at zero temperature. Recent theoretical studies suggest two potential signatures of a QSL at finite temperatures, namely a scaling behavior of thermodynamic quantities in the presence of quenched disorder, and a two-step release of the magnetic entropy.

arxiv-2110-12794.title: Mixed precision in Graphics Processing Unit
arxiv-2110-12794.creator: Quentin Gallouédec
arxiv-2110-12794.description: Abstract Modern graphics computing units (GPUs) are designed and optimized to perform highly parallel numerical calculations. This parallelism has enabled (and promises) significant advantages, both in terms of energy performance and calculation. In this document, we take stock of the different applications of mixed precision.

arxiv-2211-05165.creator: Ye Liu, Semih Yavuz, Rui Meng, Dragomir Radev, Caiming Xiong, Yingbo Zhou
arxiv-2211-05165.description: Abstract Parsing natural language questions into executable logical forms is a useful and interpretable way to perform question answering on structured data such as knowledge bases (KB) or databases (DB). arxiv-2406-12440.title: Deep Self-supervised Learning with Visualisation for Automatic Gesture Recognition
arxiv-2406-12440.creator: Fabien ALLEMAND, Alessio MAZZELLA, Jun VILLETTE, Decky ASPANDI LATIF, Titus ZAHARIA
arxiv-2406-12440.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Fabien ALLEMAND, Alessio MAZZELLA, Jun VILLETTE, Decky ASPANDI LATIF, Titus ZAHARIA. Gesture is an important mean of non-verbal communication, with visual modality allows human to convey information during interaction, facilitating peoples and human-machine interactions. However, it is considered difficult to automatically recognise gestures. In this work, we explore three different means to recognise hand signs using deep learning: supervised learning based methods, self-supervised methods and visualisation based techniques applied to 3D moving skeleton data.

arxiv-2411-08775.title: Algorithms in 4 4 -manifold topology
arxiv-2411-08775.creator: Stefan Bastl, Rhuaidi Burke, Rima Chatterjee, Subhankar Dey, Alison Durst, Stefan Friedl, Daniel Galvin, Alejandro García Rivas, Tobias Hirsch, Cara Hobohm, Chun-Sheng Hsueh, Marc Kegel, Frieda Kern, Shun Ming Samuel Lee, Clara Löh, Naageswaran Manikandan, Léo Mousseau, Lars Munser, Mark Pencovitch,
arxiv-2411-08775.description: Abstract . We show that there exists an algorithm that takes as input two closed, simply connected, topological 4 4 -manifolds and decides whether or not these 4 4 -manifolds are homeomorphic. In particular, we explain in detail how closed, simply connected, topological 4 4 -manifolds can be naturally represented by a Kirby diagram consisting only of 2 2 -handles.

arxiv-2510-08937.title: Cognitive Radio for Asymmetric Cellular Downlink with Multi-User MIMO

arxiv-2510-08937.description: Abstract Cognitive radio (CR) is an important technique for improving spectral efficiency, letting a secondary system operate in a wireless spectrum when the primary system does not make use of it. While it has been widely explored over the past 25 years, many common assumptions are not aligned with the realities of 5G networks.

pmc-13221135.creator: Grace E Hey, Chloe L DeYoung, Kathleen S Botterbush, Erin N Walker, Maryam Rahman
pmc-13221135.description: Neurosurgical oncology, which specifically focuses on the treatment of central nervous system tumors, emerged in 1879 after Dr. William Macewen successfully completed the first brain tumor resection.
